description.value: Nanyang Asian Supermarket is a full-service Asian grocery supermarket located in Surrey's Fleetwood area, occupying a multi-unit ground-floor retail space. It carries the range of products expected of an Asian-focused supermarket, making it a useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists seeking specialty ingredients alongside everyday staples.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 33m; stands (2 spaces) at 54m. Total: 4 spaces.
